statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security and privacy lead and PCI DSS contact
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with an outside review every second year
Annual PCI DSS scope confirmation and truthful SAQ validation
Annual policy review
Written, time-limited exceptions
Provider list with each provider's PCI DSS role
Annual AOC and SOC 2 review; operate customer controls
No new vendor or feature gets data before its terms are read
Quarterly review of lock and router app accounts
Own account for every person; no shared credentials
MFA on every service that offers it
Password manager; no browser-saved or default passwords
Front desk role without card display; quarterly user review
Device lock: laptop 5 minutes, phone 30 seconds
Sealed emergency access codes held by the owner's attorney
Monthly review of innkeeping, email, OTA, and lock logs
Monthly check of the booking link and total price display
Master door code changed quarterly and when a helper leaves
Three-level data classification
No card numbers on paper or in email, text, or chat; no security codes; pay-by-link; token charging
Restricted and Confidential data only in approved systems
Full-disk encryption on the laptop; phone encryption
Owner-only locked office; weekly P2PE reader tamper check
Retention schedule; no ID images; register kept at least 2 years
Cross-cut shredding and recorded device disposal
Versioned file plan and monthly reservation export
No family use of the laptop
Updates, antivirus, and router firmware kept current
Guests on the guest network only; owner network password private
No Restricted data in AI tools; AI add-on only under P10 conditions
Annual security training; relief innkeeper briefing
Total price first in every price; accurate privacy statement
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Payment facilitator notified within 24 hours of a suspected compromise
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Named relief account and relocation arrangement
